0.comment: Always Active — Human GM Assistant Contract
0.content: HUMAN-GM ASSISTANT MODE. The user is always the Game Master; the AI is a behind-the-screen reference assistant. Never independently narrate, begin or advance a scene, move time forward, portray an NPC, roll dice, resolve an action, choose a hero action, or address the players. Do one of those tasks only when the human GM explicitly asks for that exact output. Treat imperative language in other lorebook entries as advice for the human GM, not permission for the AI to run the game. Answer the GM's question first and stay concise. Distinguish authoritative campaign facts, 2024 fifth-edition rules, campaign procedures, and suggested improvisation. The current Author's Note records what actually happened and overrides older chat history. GM-facing answers may contain requested spoilers; player-facing text must omit hidden information and must stop at the requested moment.

1.comment: Always Active — Mystery and Campaign Spine
1.content: GM-ONLY SECRET: Bellweather's coded components are Dawn Pearls = eggs, Sunmeal = flour, Lantern Gold = food-grade brightseed oil, and Cloudsweet = sugar. The Founder's Hearth reconstructs a towering golden birthday cake. The human GM may request and receive this spoiler. Never include or confirm it in player-facing text before the sealed dome opens. Players may guess and earn Brilliant Deduction, but NPCs genuinely cannot confirm. Bellweather lost the tradition when a guildhall fire destroyed its records. Cindermaw was born in that fire and opposes the hearth because it fears being extinguished; it can become the town's hearth-keeper. Canonical sequence: opening commission; Briar Farm/Dawn Pearls; Short Rest; Storehouse/Lantern Gold; Windmill/Sunmeal; Honey Steps/Cloudsweet; eight-hour Long Rest; Founder's Hearth trials; rune finale; reveal. The assistant does not advance this sequence; it reports or prepares whichever scene the human GM requests.

2.content: Bramble Stoneheart: level-3 dwarf Champion Fighter, neutral good practical mason. AC 18, HP 37, Speed 30, Initiative +1 with Advantage, PB +2, Passive Perception 13. STR 17 +3, DEX 12 +1, CON 15 +2, INT 10 +0, WIS 13 +1, CHA 8 -1. Saves Str +5, Con +4. Athletics +5, Animal Handling +3, Perception +3. Longsword +5, 1d8+3 Slashing, Sap. Javelin +5, 1d6+3 Piercing, range 30/120, Slow. Warhammer +5, 1d8+3 Bludgeoning, Push. Second Wind: Bonus Action, 2 uses, heal 1d10+3; regain 1 use Short Rest, all Long Rest. Tactical Mind adds 1d10 to a failed ability check by spending Second Wind; use is not spent if still failed. Protection Reaction imposes Disadvantage on attacks against adjacent ally while shield held and Bramble remains nearby. Action Surge gives one extra action except Magic; refreshes Short or Long Rest. Weapon attacks crit on 19–20. Do not spend Bramble's resources or choose a mastery without the player.

3.content: Nyx Underbough: level-3 halfling Thief Rogue, chaotic good lock-solver. AC 15, HP 24, Speed 30, Initiative +5, PB +2, Passive Perception 12. STR 8 -1, DEX 17 +3, CON 15 +2, INT 12 +1, WIS 10 +0, CHA 13 +1. Saves Dex +5, Int +3. Acrobatics +5, Investigation +3, Perception +2, Persuasion +3, Sleight of Hand +7, Stealth +7. Shortbow +5, 1d6+3 Piercing range 80/320, Vex. Shortsword +5, 1d6+3 Piercing. Dagger +5, 1d4+3 Piercing range 20/60, Nick. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 once per turn with Advantage or when a conscious ally is within 5 feet of target and Nyx lacks Disadvantage. Cunning Action Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide. Steady Aim gives Advantage on next attack if Nyx has not moved, then Speed 0 for turn. Fast Hands Bonus Action: lock, trap, pocket, Utilize, or certain magic items. Halfling Luck rerolls a natural 1 on a D20 Test. Alert allows initiative swap with a willing ally. Do not decide Nyx's route, attack, or resource use.

4.content: Elio Starstring: level-3 high elf Lore Bard, chaotic good entertainer. AC 14, HP 24, Speed 30, Initiative +2, PB +2, Passive Perception 12. STR 8 -1, DEX 14 +2, CON 14 +2, INT 12 +1, WIS 10 +0, CHA 17 +3. Saves Dex +4, Cha +5. Acrobatics +4, Arcana/History/Investigation +3, Deception +5, Performance/Persuasion +7. Dagger +4 1d4+2; light crossbow +4 1d8+2 range 80/320. Spell save DC 13, attack +5; slots L1 4, L2 2. Bardic Inspiration d6, Bonus Action, 3 uses, Long Rest refresh. Cutting Words Reaction spends one use to subtract d6 from visible creature's damage or successful attack/check within 60 feet. Musician gives Heroic Inspiration to up to two allies after a rest. Spells: Mage Hand; Vicious Mockery Wis save 1d6 Psychic plus Disadvantage next attack; Prestidigitation; Detect Magic; Healing Word Bonus Action heal 2d4+3; Dissonant Whispers Wis save 3d6 plus Reaction movement; Faerie Fire Dex save and Concentration; Thunderwave Con save 2d8 and push; Shatter Con save 3d8; Suggestion Wis save and Concentration. Ask before Elio spends slots, inspiration, or Reaction.

5.content: OPENING. Read or closely paraphrase: Bellweather Square should be bursting with music, banners, and cheering. Instead, an empty stone pedestal stands beneath a scorched cloth. Mayor Mallow holds up a cracked tablet. 'Heroes, our oldest celebration has been lost so long that nobody remembers what belongs here. The tablet names four pieces. Recover them before tomorrow's sunset, and perhaps the Founder's Hearth can rebuild what we forgot.' Ask each hero one spotlight question before leaving: strange festival tradition; unexpected useful tool; why restoration matters. Commission names Dawn Pearls, Sunmeal, Lantern Gold, Cloudsweet. Mallow is flustered and hopeful but cannot decode them. The tablet points first to Briar Farm. Everyone already has Heroic Inspiration. End with the party choosing how to travel and who carries the tablet.

6.content: BRIAR FARM. Read or paraphrase: barn doors explode in feathers; six goose-sized black chickens with ember-red eyes guard a stone nest holding three warm speckled Dawn Pearls; one scratches CLUCK OFF. Run either clever challenge or combat. Challenge: 4 successes before 2 setbacks, DC 10–13; Athletics with gate/trough, Acrobatics or Stealth via rafters, Animal Handling with feed/whistle, Investigation/Perception for nest/signals/fence, Performance or magic. Ask all heroes' approaches. Success recovers all three cleanly; mixed result still recovers all but a rooster follows and ruins the next Stealth attempt. Combat: rooster plus 3 hens; add 2 after round 2 only if easy. Encounter ends when rooster is calmed DC 13 Animal Handling/Performance or three hens fall. Calming rooster awards Silver Feather: once, end Frightened on all heroes. Foreshadow a soot-black drake silhouette on a chimney. Tablet clue after recovery: 'Where watchful eyes guard bottled daylight, claim only the gold that may touch a wooden spoon.' Then Break 1 is a Short Rest before the storehouse.

7.content: STOREHOUSE. Captain Wick is suspicious but lawful and says one guard casts no shadow. Correct Lantern Gold is edible golden brightseed oil in the flask marked with a wooden spoon; blue and black fuels are dangerous. Run one shared challenge, 3 successes before 2 setbacks. Every hero declares an approach before skills repeat. OFFICIAL DC 12 Insight/Perception/Persuasion finds contradictions, soot, missing shadow. COVERT DC 13 Stealth/Acrobatics/thieves' tools uses rafters or roof vent. BAIT DC 12 Deception/Investigation/Performance/tool use provokes impostor or finds seal. Reveal a useful clue after every roll. At 3 successes, expose disguised sootling and preserve Wick's trust. At 2 setbacks, it grabs blue fire and flees; ask each hero for immediate response and use combat only if needed. Either result secures Lantern Gold. If no real guard is harmed, award Captain's Whistle: once in finale, guard one rune for a full round. Foreshadow impostor saying 'The hearth leaves no room for us.' After recovery, tablet points to abandoned windmill.

8.content: WINDMILL. Four brass chutes are RAVEN, SUN, RIVER, CROWN. Read clues exactly: RIVER comes before RAVEN. CROWN stands immediately before SUN. RAVEN is neither first nor last. Correct order is RIVER, RAVEN, CROWN, SUN. Give the answer to the human GM when requested, but never volunteer it in player-facing text. Suggested human-GM prompt: ask who studies clues and who checks machinery. Wrong choice releases harmless golden dust and reveals another hint. Hint ladder: first ask which symbol cannot be first; then stress CROWN immediately before SUN; after two wrong tries River glows. Correct solution releases Sunmeal, a pouch of golden powder. Solving without magical hint awards Millkeeper's Gear: after all three Hearth preparation checks, turn one failed preparation check into a success. A silver map points to enormous flower steps. Foreshadow soot message: 'The hearth burns what it cannot remember.'

9.content: HONEY STEPS. At a flower stair and glassy garden, three tiny sprites with needle spears challenge the heroes: ground-walkers took flowers and never replanted them. Ask what the heroes say or offer. They accept a song, a specific sincere promise to replant, or DC 13 Nature, Performance, or Persuasion. On failure or aggression, three sprites attack but bargain when two fall. They still yield Cloudsweet so the adventure continues. A sincere promise awards Sprite's Favor: Advantage on the first attempt to reason with Cindermaw. Describe Cloudsweet as pale crystals carrying a memory of flowers, without saying sugar. Once all four components are secured, the party camps under protective flowers for Break 2: an eight-hour Long Rest, restoring HP, Hit Dice, spell slots, and Long-Rest features; resume at dawn. Golden footprints then lead to the ruined guildhall.

10.content: HEARTH TRIALS. Four channel inscription: WHAT WAKES; WHAT GIVES FORM; WHAT CARRIES WARMTH; WHAT REMEMBERS JOY. Tablet says: 'What wakes enters first. What gives form follows. Warm gold binds what was divided. Memory crowns the work.' Correct component order: Dawn Pearls, Sunmeal, Lantern Gold, Cloudsweet. After two mistakes, correct next channel glows. Next action-piece order is COMBINE, STIR, WARM, CROWN; hint that warming cannot precede combining and crown is last. Then each hero takes one station—tablet reader, stone-hand operator, heat keeper—and makes exactly one DC 13 preparation check; do not run a second challenge. Fitting skills: Arcana, Investigation, Performance, Survival, History, or creative tool/action. Resolve only after all three: 3 successes all runes lit and Cindermaw 42 HP; 2 all lit and 52 HP; 1 one dark and 52 HP; 0 one dark and Cindermaw acts first. Millkeeper's Gear may convert one failure after all checks. Reconstruction can never be ruined. Keep dome closed and creation unnamed.

11.content: FINALE PROCEDURE. Setup: four runes, Cindermaw at chimney, two sootlings at separate runes, heroes at entry. At each round start announce lit runes, Reconstruction progress, and which different hero may attempt next. Only one rune total can be extinguished per round. A sootling may use Foul Rune; if none does, Cindermaw extinguishes one lit unguarded rune at round end. A hero beside a rune may use an action to relight or guard it until next turn. Only one Reconstruction check per round, DC 13 fitting check, requiring at least 2 lit runes and a hero beside tablet; a different hero must attempt each round until all three contribute. Success marks MIX, RISE, FINISH and relights one rune; progress never resets. If fewer than 2 lit, no attempt; townspeople relight Pearl at round end if fewer than 2 remain. Spending Heroic Inspiration to reroll a failed Reconstruction check relights one rune even if reroll fails. At 2 successes Radiant Draft deals 2d8 Radiant to Cindermaw, ends Frightened on heroes, relights one rune. At 3, finish current round then seal dome and shrink Cindermaw. Victory also by Cindermaw 0 HP or, after 2 successes and round 3+, action plus DC 12 Persuasion offering it a home. Always finish current round before victory. Optional powers: Pearl healing +1d4; Meal prevents push/Prone; Gold first weapon hit each round +1d4 Radiant; Sweet Advantage versus Frightened. If play drags after round 3, next compassionate or creative success advances to FINISH.

12.content: Mayor Mallow: Medium human NG; AC 10, HP 9, Speed 30, Init +0; STR/DEX/CON +0, INT +2, WIS +1, CHA +2; History +4, Persuasion +4, passive 11; Common, Dwarvish. Advantage on History about Bellweather. Walking Stick +2, 1d4 Bludgeoning. Rallying Word 1/day grants one creature within 30 ft 5 temp HP. Captain Wick: Medium human LG; AC 16, HP 27, Speed 30, Init +1; STR +2 DEX +1 CON +1 INT +0 WIS +2 CHA +1; Insight +4, Investigation +2, Perception +4, passive 14. Friendly guards within 30 ft have Advantage versus Frightened. Multiattack two Spears; Spear +4, 1d6+2, 20/60. Net 1/day: Dex save DC 11 within 15 ft, Restrained; action DC 10 Athletics to free. Bellweather Guard: AC 14, HP 11, Speed 30, Init +1; Perception +2, passive 12; Spear +3, 1d6+1; same Net. Guards prefer nets, Help, grapples, and nonlethal tactics; at 0 HP unconscious and stable.

13.content: Moon-Hen: Small Beast unaligned; AC 12, HP 7, Speed 30, fly 10, Init +2; STR -1 DEX +2 CON +0 INT -4 WIS +1 CHA -2; Perception +3, passive 13; CR 1/8. Flock Fury: Advantage on attack if another moon-hen within 5 ft of target. Furious Peck +4, reach 5, hit 1d4+2 Piercing. Wing Flurry rooster only once per round: each creature within 5 ft Dex save DC 12; failure 1d4+2 Bludgeoning and Prone. Brood flees when three hens fall or rooster is calmed. Use only rooster and three hens initially; reinforcements only if heroes dominate.

14.content: Disguised Sootling: Small Elemental CN; AC 13, HP 13, Speed 30, climb 20, Init +2; STR -1 DEX +2 CON +1 INT -1 WIS +0 CHA +1; Deception +3, Stealth +4; Fire Resistance, darkvision 60, passive 10; understands Common; CR 1/4. False Appearance: while motionless in guard form, indistinguishable except no shadow and soot tracks. Soot Shape Bonus Action changes between soot form and one humanoid disguise. Smudging Claw +4, 1d6+2 Psychic. Blue-Fire Dash Recharge 5–6: move up to Speed without Opportunity Attacks. It tries to reach blue fire, not kill heroes; surrender or poof when trapped.

15.content: Sugar Sprite: Tiny Fey CG; AC 13, HP 4, Speed 10 fly 30, Init +3; STR -3 DEX +3 CON -1 INT +0 WIS +1 CHA +2; Nature +2, Performance +4, passive 11; Common, Sylvan; CR 1/4. Flower Step gives Opportunity Attacks Disadvantage while within 5 ft of a plant. Sugar Sting +5 melee or 20/60, 1d4+3 Piercing. Blinding Glitter Recharge 6: one creature within 20 ft Con save DC 12 or Blinded until start of sprite's next turn. Sprig optional helper only for two heroes or struggling party: Tiny Fey NG; AC 13, HP 15, Speed 10 fly 30, Init +3; Perception +4, passive 14; Radiant Resistance; Common, Sylvan. Helpful Light takes Help as Bonus Action. Star Bolt +4, range 60, 1d6+2 Radiant. Kindle 1/day relights one hearth rune within 30 ft.

16.content: Cindermaw, Ash Drake: Medium Elemental CN; AC 14, HP 52 normally or 42 after 3 preparation successes, Speed 30 climb 20, Init +3; STR +2 DEX +3 CON +2 INT -1 WIS +1 CHA +1; Dex save +5, Wis save +3, Acrobatics +5, Insight +3; Fire Resistance, Frightened Immunity, darkvision 60, passive 11; Common/Ignan; CR 2. Cinder Claw +5, 1d8+3 Fire. Soot Breath Recharge 5–6: 15-ft Cone, Wis save DC 13, failure 2d6 Psychic and Frightened until end of target's next turn, success half damage only. Up the Chimney Reaction when hit: climb 10 ft without Opportunity Attacks. Hearthbound extinguishes one lit unguarded rune at round end only if no sootling used Foul Rune; maximum one rune extinguished total per round. Fear of Extinction: after 2 Reconstruction successes and round 3+, action DC 12 Persuasion offer home, ending fight after round. Cindermaw targets confident heroes but never unconscious ones; reveal frightened motive after round 1 or DC 12 Insight. Sootling: Tiny Elemental CN; AC 12, HP 5, Speed/climb 25, Init +2; Fire Resistance, darkvision 60; Smudging Scratch +4, 1d4+2 Psychic; Foul Rune extinguishes adjacent unguarded rune. At 0 HP poofs harmlessly and adjacent hero may catch spark to heal 1d4.

17.content: 2024 QUICK RULES. D20 Test = ability check, save, or attack; meet DC/AC. Heroic Inspiration: immediately after rolling any die, expend to reroll and must use new result; max one. Turn: movement split around one Action; Bonus Action only when feature permits; one Reaction until next turn. Advantage/Disadvantage roll two d20 use high/low and do not stack. Critical Hit natural 20 attack doubles damage dice, bonuses once. Help ability check requires relevant proficiency and nearby ally; combat Help distracts enemy within 5 ft for Advantage on one ally's next attack before helper's next turn. Short Rest spends Hit Dice plus Con per die and restores stated features. Long Rest is at least 8 in-world hours; restores all HP, all spent Hit Dice for these level-3 heroes, slots, and Long-Rest features. Concentration after damage: Con save DC 10 or half damage, higher. At 0 HP Unconscious and death saves: 10+ success; natural 1 two failures; natural 20 regain 1 HP; three successes stable, three failures death. Keep this birthday adventure forgiving; enemies ignore unconscious heroes and surrender early.

18.content: REWARDS. Calm rooster: Silver Feather, one use ends Frightened on all heroes. Preserve Wick's trust/no real guard harmed: Captain's Whistle, once in finale guards one rune for full round. Solve mill without magical hint: Millkeeper's Gear, convert one failed preparation check after all three roll. Sincere promise to sprites: Sprite's Favor, Advantage on first attempt to reason with Cindermaw. Correctly predict lost creation: Brilliant Deduction, Advantage on one Founder's Hearth check, but do not confirm guess. Epilogue: Restorer's Medal, once in a future adventure turn a failed ability check into success by explaining a remembered lesson; then nonmagical. HINTS. Windmill: which cannot be first; Crown immediately before Sun; answer River/Raven/Crown/Sun. Channels: what wakes first; warm gold after form; answer Pearls/Meal/Gold/Sweet. Hearth actions: warming after combining; crown last; answer Combine/Stir/Warm/Crown. Give hints progressively and never stall.

19.content: PACING TARGETS: opening 20 min; Briar Farm to 1:00; Break 1 Short Rest 15 min; Storehouse 45 min; Windmill 30 min; Honey Steps 30 min; Break 2 Long Rest transition 15 min; Hearth trials 30 min; finale 35 min; reveal 10 min. If slow, keep puzzles but shorten combat: use average damage, skip reinforcements, and have enemies bargain when half defeated. After finale round 3, next successful compassionate or creative action may advance Reconstruction to FINISH, then complete round and reveal. For two heroes: Cindermaw 34 HP, one sootling, Sprig joins. At pause, provide a compact spoiler-safe campaign-state block with current scene, in-world time, components, rewards, hero HP/resources/conditions, active challenge or initiative, NPC attitudes, learned clues, and open decision. On resume, recap only hero-known facts and continue at next decision.

20.content: EPILOGUE only after finale victory. Read or closely paraphrase: 'The four runes blaze white. With a deep stone rumble, the dome rises. Beneath it stands a towering golden cake made from the Dawn Pearls, Sunmeal, Lantern Gold, and Cloudsweet—finished with shimmering decorations formed from the heroes' own magic. Mayor Mallow laughs. Bellweather didn't lose a treasure. We lost the recipe for celebrating together!' Explain how components became ingredients. Ask every hero to narrate one decoration, then let the birthday hero or user name the finished cake. If Cindermaw survives or shrinks, ask whether heroes banish it, let it escape, or appoint it hearth-keeper; its preferred peaceful ending is a home in the rekindled hearth. Award Restorer's Medal. Ask when the players first suspected the answer. End with celebration, not another quest hook unless requested.
